title: Shapes from Examples: Foundations of Shape Learning in Recursive SHACL
abstract: arXiv:2607.27934v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: SHACL shapes enable data graph validation, making automatic shape learning essential for knowledge graph applications. We investigate the well-known fitting approach to this task: given sets P and N of positive and negative example nodes from an input graph, compute a shape expression C, possibly using shape names defined in a recursive shape catalogue, that validates at every node in P and none in N. We focus on the case where C is written in a core fragment of SHACL corresponding to the Description Logic ELI*. For the catalogue, we consider the well-founded, stable, and supported semantics. We address fitting existence and most specific fitting computation, establish tight exponential-time upper bounds for both problems, and obtain polynomial bounds for relevant special cases.

translated_title: 从示例中学习形状：递归SHACL中形状学习的理论基础
translated_abstract: SHACL形状能够实现数据图的验证，因此自动形状学习对知识图谱应用至关重要。我们研究了该任务中广为人知的拟合方法：给定输入图中正例节点集合P和负例节点集合N，计算一个形状表达式C（其可使用递归形状目录中定义的形状名称），使得C在P中的每个节点上都验证通过，而在N中的所有节点上均验证失败。我们关注C由SHACL核心片段（对应于描述逻辑ELI*）书写的情形。对于形状目录，我们考虑了良基、稳定和支持三种语义。我们研究了拟合的存在性与最具体拟合的计算问题，为这两个问题建立了紧凑的指数时间上界，并针对相关特殊情形获得了多项式界。
tldr: 该论文研究从正负例节点学习递归SHACL形状的拟合问题，针对对应描述逻辑ELI*的SHACL核心片段，在良基、稳定和支持三种目录语义下，为拟合存在性与最具体拟合计算建立了紧凑的指数时间上界，并在特殊情形下给出了多项式界。
en_tdlr: This paper studies the fitting problem of learning recursive SHACL shapes from positive and negative examples, establishing tight exponential-time upper bounds for fitting existence and most specific fitting computation in the SHACL core fragment corresponding to Description Logic ELI* under well-founded, stable, and supported catalogue semantics, with polynomial bounds for special cases.
